about: One voice per speaker: authored pre-rendered lines and registered theme metadata (tactics.npc.<id>). Tactics uses recordings only; missing clips never enable live TTS. Presets are Gemini TTS / Chirp3-HD voice names (en-US-Chirp3-HD-<preset>). Player voice sets have two casts each (low, high). NPCs have one; where two speakers must share a preset, a pitch shift (semitones) or a filter keeps them apart in the pre-rendered clips. Filters can't reach live TTS, so major speakers get presets of their own. The ArcBox host (lobby) is Puck, so Wardenflame keeps Puck off its speakers.

filters.helm: A voice inside a closed helm: short metallic reflections and the top end rolled off.
filters.echo: A faint cold echo, as if the room were larger and older than it looks.
filters.fey: A soft shimmer: a quiet, slightly detuned double behind the voice.

dagna_holt.note: Owner-approved mature veteran captain: low, flat Northern delivery, grounded and lightly weathered. Shares grim.high preset; authored direction distinguishes her.
dagna_holt.direction: Mature female guard captain, late forties to fifties. Low, flat Northern English delivery. Grounded chest resonance, lightly weathered texture, restrained grief and calm clipped authority. No youthful brightness, frailty or theatrical growling. Speak only the dialogue.

old_maud.direction: A woman aged105. Ancient, dry, papery voice with age-cracked creak, light breathy quaver and frail breath support. Soft low-mid register. Unhurried short phrases with small natural pauses. Warm, wry rural English manner; perfectly lucid and self-possessed. Clearly very elderly, not a young actress speaking slowly, not the firm resonant guard captain. No cartoon witch or theatrical croak. Speak only the dialogue.
